scope: Derived engineering obligations for every atomic AIQ task.

inheritance_policy.rule: Each AIQ task inherits the union of engineering obligations from every work_package_ref. Inheritance may only be reduced by an explicit, reviewable not-applicable disposition; task completion never erases capability-level promotion gates.
inheritance_policy.no_shortcut: A task may remain queue-complete for historical/accountability purposes while engineering evidence is still pending; such completion cannot be cited as verified/hardened/production engineering proof.

tasks.implementation_packet_rule: Before implementation review, the task packet must disposition every inherited engineering dimension and name concrete artifacts or explicit not-applicable rationale.
tasks.strong_promotion_rule: AIQ task completion is not equivalent to verified/hardened/production capability status. Strong promotion requires bound budgets, executable evidence, recovery/compatibility proof, independent verification and signed accountability under the engineering pass.
